comment.body: The issue already includes a PowerToys report and confirms Windows detects the monitors. Please test one affected display directly with ddcutil using VCP code 0x10, and report the monitor model, connection type, and whether the command succeeds. This will distinguish Power Display enumeration from a DDC/CI or adapter limitation; please do not upload duplicate logs unless the result changes after a fresh /bugreport.
